description: Public-safe provider registry for the MMIR frontend. Status labels are product truth labels, not live telemetry. Live status must later come from a protected MMIR API or paired local node.

providers.label: Local Connector
providers.route: MMIR frontend -> paired local connector -> local model runtime
providers.notes: Local-first path is the current MVP focus. Raw Ollama ports should stay private and the connector must be hardened before broad use.

providers.label: Compatible Backend
providers.notes: For users who bring their own compatible backend. Secrets and provider keys must stay server-side.

providers.label: Managed Provider Routing
providers.route: MMIR frontend -> api.mmir.ai -> protected provider router
providers.notes: Future managed layer for cloud model connectors, encrypted key vault, team workspaces and usage analytics.

providers.label: Fallback Demo Provider
providers.role: Lightweight fallback for demos and tests
providers.route: MMIR frontend -> protected MMIR API -> fallback provider
providers.notes: Useful for demos, tests and resilience while live provider support is being built.
